tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(daemon): env-override regression test proves delivery, not just secrecy (FIX 6.B)

TestWorkerSpawner_Run_EnvOverrideValueNeverLogged used a fixed-payload
fake claude binary, so it could only prove the env var's value never
appeared in the captured log -- it said nothing about whether the value
actually reached the subprocess. A stub that ignores its environment
entirely would pass this test exactly as well as a correct one; the class
of bug FIX 3 fixed (a wrong context7 header, silently never actually
authenticating) is precisely a delivery failure this test's original
shape could never have caught.

writeEnvEchoingClaudeBinary replaces the fixed-payload stub: it reads the
named env var back and embeds its LENGTH (never the value) in its JSON
output. Length, not the value, is deliberate -- WorkerSpawner.Run itself
logs the worker's raw stdout for diagnostics, so echoing the secret
verbatim would make it appear in the captured log through that entirely
separate, legitimate logging path, defeating the non-logging assertion
the test still needs to hold at the same time. Renamed to
TestWorkerSpawner_Run_EnvOverrideDeliveredAndNeverLogged; both assertions
are required together, each guards against a way the other is
satisfiable in a misleading way.
EOF
)"
